message:
This PR addresses a stability issue in panic handling within sei-chain.
Previously, if a nil logger was passed into LogPanicCallback, a secondary panic could occur, masking the original error.
Additionally, this PR strengthens test coverage for panic recovery and tracer timeout scenarios.

🔧 Changes

utils/panic.go

Updated LogPanicCallback to safely handle nil loggers and provide structured logging for recovered panics.

utils/panic_test.go

Added TestLogPanicCallback to ensure panic recovery does not fail when logger is missing.

x/epoch/types/hooks.go

Simplified defer usage to consistently wrap with PanicHandler(LogPanicCallback).

evmrpc/tracers_test.go

Added timeout simulation (time.Sleep(2s)) to validate tracer behavior under slow node responses.

Upgrade Support

Includes scaffolding for v6.1.4 upgrade (fix(v614)).

Codex JSON Files (⚠️ subject to removal before merge)

.codex/keys/hotfix-august.jso

.codex/paywords.json

These files currently contain test key/rotation data. They should not be merged into main if sensitive.

✅ Testing

Ran go test ./... locally — all tests pass.

Verified new test TestLogPanicCallback behaves as expected.

Manually simulated slow RPC node response for tracer timeout test.

⚠️ Risks & Considerations

Ensure .codex/*.json files are excluded before merging if they contain sensitive or environment-specific data.

The panic handling change affects multiple modules that rely on deferred recovery — careful review is recommended.
